text:
Priya: Heads-up, saw a correlated perf regression and PCIe AER spikes in rack23 this morning. embedder-v2 pods' p95 token latency doubled for a subset of requests. Observed repeated `AER: Uncorrected` and bus resets on GPU IDs gpu23-2 and gpu23-5.

Sam: Can you paste the grep of the kernel logs? guessing Xid 31/43 pattern?

Priya: Sure — tail from node rack23-node05: `Apr 12 09:17:03 kernel: pci 0000:5e:00.1: AER: Uncorrected (severity=263)`, `Xid 31, GPU hang`, then `bus reset detected by pci_bus` a few seconds later. Error counters increased: AER=12 -> 48 in 30m.

Matt: Thanks. Is this persistent across reboots or intermittent? Any correlation with NVLink peer messages?

Priya: Flaky pattern — bursts every 10–20 minutes. NVLink link state logs show `link training failed` for the peer on gpu23-5 around same times. Not classical heat ramp (temps ~68C steady).

Raj: OK — probable board-level signal integrity issue or riser/slot. I recommend draining gpu23-5 first and moving workloads off gpu23-2 as standby. If drain reduces p95 back to normal we can schedule a hot-swap/reslot during off-peak.

Elena: We have capacity in us-west-2 spare pool but moving pods there will add cross-region egress and SLO risk for some customers. What's the impact window if we drain whole node?

Sam: Quick mitigation: we can evict the two affected GPUs and let pods land on other nodes in the same AZ. Use this command to cordon & drain gracefully: `redwoodctl node cordon rack23-node05 && redwoodctl drain --node rack23-node05 --gpu-ids 2,5 --grace 300`. That keeps most pods local.

Priya: Ran the drain command in staging patch; p95 back to baseline within 2 minutes after evictions. Doing the same in prod now.

drain-bot: Started graceful drain for rack23-node05 (gpus 2,5). ETA 5m.

Matt: Once drained, please capture `lspci -vvv` and `nvidia-smi -q` outputs and leave the node powered on but isolated so hwops can RMA if needed. Also snapshot the nvlink debug trace: `/var/log/nvlink-trace.log` around the events.

Priya: Collected outputs and uploaded to /internal/infra/incidents/rack23/2156789012/. lspci shows `AER: status: non-fatal` repeated; nvlink-trace has `training_failed` entries at 09:16:58, 09:26:41, 09:36:12.

Raj: I'll schedule tech to reseat the card and swap the riser tomorrow morning (low-impact window). If errors persist after reseat we'll RMA the board.

Elena: Ops note — since this removes ~2 GPUs from pool during swap, forecasted slot pressure for embeddings will rise ~6% for the day. Recommend enabling temporary autoscale bump for dedicated pools to avoid throttles; financial impact estimated ~$180/day if we keep it up for 24h. Approving only if SLO risk otherwise.

Sam: Also adding a transient routing rule to prefer us-east-1 capacity for embedder-v2 traffic to reduce customer-visible risk while we heal rack23 (route active for next 12h).

Priya: Post-drain prod metrics look stable. Will keep the node offline until hwops confirms reseat/swap. Marking this thread as monitoring; will update after RMA/reslot. :white_check_mark:

Matt: Thanks — please ping #incidents if errors reappear or if Xid codes change.

Raj: Scheduling tech for 03:30 UTC maintenance; will post ETA and replacement part SNs here.

Priya: Noted. Closing the immediate perf incident; tracking HW follow-up.
